title: zazzle-csharp-indexer tools capability
description: What zazzled can ask zazzle-csharp-indexer about the git work trees it serves, and so what zazzle can tell an agent.

entities.name: C# views and code structure for zazzle
entities.description: Terse views of C# files, structure, change lists, history and gap reports for the roots a session names. The server lists none of these to clients; zazzled calls them by name and offers them as zazzle tools (decisions.json, tools-beside-zazzle).
entities.responsibility: Answers zazzled's questions about the code in the configured roots compactly, from the index where it can and from git where it cannot, and records how each answer was produced.
access: tools/list is empty; zazzled calls the tools by name, and nothing stops another client of the server from doing the same. No tool checks the caller.
Through the daemon, only the socket's owner can connect (mode 0600); in process, the client is whoever started zazzle-csharp-indexer serve.
Every root must be inside a git work tree (Root.Parse); view resolves its path inside the root.
